structuredContent.body:
SDK multi-RID container publishing truncates colon-bearing label values before each child publish. The shared target rebinds the publisher-owned source, revision, version, and created labels for consumers that provide all three provenance inputs.

The overrides and rebinding require complete publisher metadata, preserving ordinary local SDK generation and partial-metadata behavior. Seven MSBuild tests cover the complete, partial, absent, disabled, single-RID, and multi-RID paths; the full publisher suite passes 142 tests.

This reapplies exactly the two reviewed files from aea707d after PR #127 restored the preincident tree. The source tree is byte-identical to the reviewed implementation; merge remains subject to every effective required context and ordinary CI. No release is authorized by this PR alone.
structuredContent.title: fix(container): preserve publisher provenance across RIDs
